} .footer-title { font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif; font-size: 40px; line-height: 1.08; color: #f2ede4; margin: 0; } .footer-heading { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #f08a5d; margin-bottom: 20px; } .footer-links { display: flex; flex-direction: column; grid-row-gap: 10px; } .footer-link { text-decoration: none; color: #c9c5bb; font-size: 15px; transition: color 300ms ease; } .footer-link:hover { color: #f2ede4; } .newsletter { display: flex; margin-top: 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(242, 237, 228, 0.25); padding: 6px; } .newsletter-input { flex: 1; height: 48px; margin-bottom: 0; border: 0; background-color: transparent; color: #f2ede4; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 15px; font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif; } .footer-wordmark { font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif; font-size: 260px; line-height: 0.8; color: #f2ede4; letter-spacing: -0.04em; border-top: 1px solid rgba(242, 237, 228, 0.14); padding-top: 48px; } .footer-wordmark-accent { font-style: italic; color: #d4502a; } .footer-bottom { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; grid-row-gap: 12px; padding-top: 32px; font-size: 13px; } .footer-bottom-links { display: flex; grid-column-gap: 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #f2ede4; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; transition: background-color 300ms ease, border-color 300ms ease; } .social-link:hover { background-color: #d4502a;
